Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Enum LatencyMetric

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<LatencyMetric>
      • com.kristensoft.kdc.LatencyMetric
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable, Comparable<LatencyMetric>
    public enum LatencyMetric
extends Enum<LatencyMetric>
    Identifies the individual latency measurements collected by KDC.

    Each metric represents a stage of agent or reply communication and processing. Metrics are grouped into LatencyContext values according to the type of communication operation.

    Each metric provides an abbreviated title suitable for use in diagnostic output and performance reports.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed
    See Also:
    LatencyContext, LatencyRecord
